new: This release repairs v219, which went out before its review: the start page fetched every story after 30 seconds, and a first story that failed to load left a headset on the loading card.
Every story is fetched again when the app installs or updates; only the files that changed are downloaded, and a slow network no longer holds the update back.
A story file caught half way through a deploy is no longer kept on the device.
In a shared room the limited headset menu has Calibrate (Stop calibrating while it runs) and Room setup.
A room you left on purpose is offered again when you stand in its place.
test: Enter VR or AR from the start page: the trigger works at once, in the menu and when calibrating.
The limited menu in a room: Calibrate, Stop calibrating and Room setup; Room setup offers no Fresh shared space and no new area.
An installed copy taking this update, then a story opened offline that was never opened before.
Leave a room on purpose, then stand in its place again: it is offered, not joined by itself.
untested: Everything in a headset: nothing in this release has been tried in one.

The calibration fault you saw (after the second cross both crosses were gone and the room was not lined up) could not be reproduced without a headset. One cause was found and fixed: from the start page the trigger reached nothing. Whether that was your fault is not known: it may not be fixed.
The install's download of every story on a Quest's storage and wifi, and a real host's deploy.
